verdict.rationale: PayPal offers hosted checkout via PayPal Checkout button and payment links (no-code, redirect-based, PayPal-hosted UI), plus invoicing pages that let merchants get paid via a secure PayPal payment page without building their own flow. Docs also show server-side integration for handling capture/refunds, indicating a redirect-to-hosted-page flow is well supported. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on conversion-rate evidence or third-party validation of the 'conversion-optimized' claim beyond vendor marketing copy.
